requests.name: Test Guest
requests.message: We want to book a birthday party for 20 people!

requests.name: Sofia Marchetti
requests.message: Hi! We'd love to book a private party for my daughter's 10th birthday. We're looking at a Saturday in July, around 24 kids plus parents. Do you have a private room or can you accommodate a big group? We'd want a set menu with pizza and some appetizers. Budget is flexible. Please let me know availability and pricing. Thank you so much!
requests.notes: Called Sofia to confirm. Set menu agreed: 4 pies, garlic knots, salad, soft drinks. Deposit received $200.

requests.name: Marcus Webb
requests.message: Hey, looking to book a birthday dinner for my buddy turning 40. About 15 people, Friday night. Would need the space from like 7pm-10pm. Open bar possible? Let me know what you can do.

requests.name: Priya Nair
requests.message: Hello! I'm interested in hosting a corporate team lunch for about 30 people sometime in August. We'd want a private or semi-private setup, family-style food. Is that something you can do on a weekday? Please send pricing info.
